openings.claim: Personal loose-material staging may reduce picking omissions by reducing crossed reaches; O4 does not yet establish this mechanism.
openings.delta: Replace the unmatched small-batch comparison with matched pattern counts, equal checking and counterbalanced volunteer exposure.
openings.prediction: With identical pattern mixtures and audits, personal staging produces fewer crossed reaches and fewer missing items before checking, without increasing total setup, assembly and checking time.
openings.rival_prediction: The nearest alternative is that O4 benefited from its pattern mixture or unequal checking. Matched mixtures and equivalent audits remove its omission and timing advantage even if reaches decline.
openings.defeat: Personal staging reduces reaches but leaves omissions unchanged or higher, or its setup and checking erase the time advantage; inability to fit defeats this layout's feasibility.
openings.probe: Use twelve of the sixty required kits: each volunteer assembles one kit of each pattern under each layout, in opposite layout orders. Preserve specified contents. Tally reaches, elapsed setup/assembly/check time, and omissions before correction; use identical audits. Use exactly two volunteers, existing materials, and only the existing table; attempt loose staging only if it fits. Count the probe and corrections inside the overall ninety-minute limit. Pencil assigned patterns on all twelve envelopes as a common distribution safeguard, not a tested benefit.
assumptions: Both layouts fit with existing supplies; this must be checked before staging.
The required assignment includes enough kits of each pattern for matching.
A twelve-kit comparison can reveal a decision-changing difference; a tie remains inconclusive.

decision: Proceed only with the bounded matched probe after its feasibility checks. Its guarded design preserves hard constraints; no supplied synthetic stipulation proves the eventual intervention delivers complete, correctly assigned kits to participants within ninety minutes with at most one distribution correction, or reduces volunteer burden.

unresolved.issue: Picking versus filling failures and small-batch comparability remain untested.
Envelope identification is independently required; pencilling patterns has no tested distribution outcome.
Supply continuity, table occupancy and sixty-kit completion remain unproven.
